records.statement: ECM pinout on the 2026 CRF450X, as pin, Honda's signal label and wire colour: A-1 IGP (power in), black/red; A-2 PRC, black/white; A-3 FLCNT, gray/red; A-4 INJ1 (fuel injector), pink/white; A-5 FLR (fuel pump relay), white; A-6 PG1 (power ground), green/black; A-7 WARN (warning indicator), white/blue; A-8 ST RLY (starter relay), yellow/red; A-9 PCS (crank position sensor), yellow/black; A-10 EX-AI, pink/black; A-11 IG (ignition coil), yellow/blue; A-12 VCC (5 V sensor supply), red/yellow; A-15 TH (throttle position signal), yellow/green; A-16 BA (bank angle (tip-over) sensor), red/blue; A-17 SG (sensor ground), green/red; A-18 GP (gear position), black/green; A-19 TA (intake air temperature signal), gray/blue; A-21 TW (coolant temperature signal), pink; A-22 PG (power ground), green/black; A-23 PCM (crank position sensor), blue/yellow; A-24 PCP (crank position sensor), white/yellow; A-26 K-LINE (diagnostic line), orange/black; A-27 PB (intake pressure (MAP) signal), green/yellow; A-28 SCS (service check), blue; A-29 ST SW (starter switch), black/orange; A-32 EGN STOP SW (engine stop switch), light green; A-33 LG (logic ground), green/white. Wire colours are base/stripe.

source.name: Honda 2026 CRF450X competition handbook, wiring diagram (PDF page 124)

records.topic: Sensor and switch wire colours at the ECM
records.statement: Wire colours at the ECM on the 2026 CRF450X: 5 V sensor supply red/yellow; sensor ground green/red; throttle position signal yellow/green; intake pressure signal green/yellow; intake air temperature signal gray/blue; coolant temperature signal pink; crank position sensor yellow/black and blue/yellow and white/yellow; fuel injector (ECM side) pink/white; ignition coil (ECM side) yellow/blue; gear position black/green; engine stop switch light green; starter switch black/orange; diagnostic line orange/black. The three-wire sensors share the 5 V supply and the sensor ground. Honda's colour letters: Bl black, Y yellow, Bu blue, G green, R red, W white, Br brown, O orange, Lb light blue, Lg light green, P pink, Gr gray.

source.name: Honda 2026 CRF450X competition handbook, wiring diagram (PDF page 124)
